title: Day one of SynTech at the University of Greenwich
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
Day one of SynTech at the University of Greenwich.


This three-day conference brings together work across electrochemistry, flow, photochemistry, and AI for synthesis.


For the next three days we are exhibiting at stall 7. If you are here and thinking about data-driven reaction optimization, HTE, or where machine learning for process development, come and say hello.
